region: Pinellas Trail: Clearwater to Tarpon Springs

events.title: Downtown Community Market, Halloween edition
events.summary: Evening market in downtown Palm Harbor, moved from Oct. 17 because of weather. Costume contests start at 6 p.m.

events.title: Tarpon Springs First Friday
events.address: 324 E Pine St, Tarpon Springs, FL
events.summary: Monthly evening gathering in the historic downtown on the first Friday of the month.

events.title: Tarpon Springs Seafood Festival
events.address: Dodecanese Blvd & Hill St, Tarpon Springs, FL
events.summary: Two-day seafood, arts and crafts festival at the Sponge Docks. Saturday runs late; Sunday wraps up at 5.

events.title: Wine Around Palm Harbor
events.summary: Outdoor wine and food tasting on the museum grounds, with a table for each of seven historic local communities. Benefits the museum.

events.title: Dunedin Celtic Festival
events.cost: $20 in advance, $27 at the gate; 12 and under free
events.summary: Dunedin's Scottish heritage on display: music, food and a whisky tasting add-on. Put on by the Dunedin Scottish Arts Foundation.

events.title: Downtown Community Market
events.summary: Daytime community market in downtown Palm Harbor.

events.title: Dunedin Downtown Market
events.summary: Saturday market in downtown Dunedin. From November through June it sets up in Pioneer Park on Main Street.

events.title: Books & Beyond Book Club
events.address: 138 E Lemon St, Tarpon Springs, FL 34689
events.summary: This month's book is Shelter in Place by Nora Roberts.

events.title: Show Car Soirée: Trunk or Treat at Fenway
events.summary: Decorated show cars and trunk-or-treating on the Fenway Front Lawn. Free and open to the public; the hotel asks guests to RSVP. Valet parking is $10, waived with a food or drink purchase at the hotel.

events.title: Dunedin Downtown Market
events.summary: Last Saturday of the summer season. A good ride-to stop on the Pinellas Trail in downtown Dunedin.
